title: Upgrade & Migration Health
objective: Memantau migration failure, duration, warning, repair, rollback, dan data comparison per source version.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan enam sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; migration_success ok sementara integrity_result failed = FAIL integrity_failure_ignored; migration_success ok sementara repair_required failed = FAIL repair_required_ignored; migration_success failed sementara rollback_result failed = FAIL migration_unrecovered; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; belum ada telemetri upgrade atau migrasi produksi yang diamati.
Perilaku kanal update end-user, skema database produksi end-to-end, publikasi distribusi, dan verifikasi upgrade lintas versi nyata tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
